default_x86_sha256_dispatch: Runtime SHA/SSE2/SSSE3/SSE4.1 check; otherwise portable software compression. Software defaults to the unrolled implementation.
interpretation: The runner lacks the required SHA feature, so default dispatch selects software SHA-256. This source/feature observation alone does not establish the fraction of pipeline cost spent hashing.
qualification: No dependency, hash algorithm, backend override, VM feature, or production verification change in this package.
